name: O-4310
summary: O-4310, also known as 1-isopropyl-6-fluoropsilocin (1-iPr-6-F-4-HO-DMT), is a serotonin receptor agonist of the tryptamine family. It is the 1-isopropylated and 6-fluorinated derivative of the serotonergic psychedelic psilocin.

pharmacology.text: The drug is said to be a serotonin 5-HT2A receptor agonist and to be highly selective for activation of this receptor over the closely related serotonin 5-HT2B and 5-HT2C receptors. Its EC50 at the serotonin 5-HT2A receptor was reported to be 5 nM and it was said to have an Emax of 89% relative to serotonin.

uses.en: It is a research compound, made to study serotonin receptors and possible treatments based on them.
uses.zh: 它是研究用化合物，用於探討血清素受體以及基於這些受體的可能療法。
uses.zhHans: 它是研究用化合物，用于探讨血清素受体以及基于这些受体的可能疗法。

fact.en: It is psilocin with a fluorine atom added and a propyl group on the ring nitrogen, changes chemists make to see whether a psychedelic's medical effects can be separated from its hallucinations.
fact.zh: 它是在裸蓋菇醇上加了一個氟原子，並在環上的氮接了丙基。化學家做這類改動，是為了測試迷幻藥的醫療作用能否與幻覺分離。
fact.zhHans: 它是在裸盖菇醇上加了一个氟原子，并在环上的氮接了丙基。化学家做这类改动，是为了测试迷幻药的医疗作用能否与幻觉分离。
